pages: atlas_r380 (units, buildings, icons) + atlas_r380fx (blast aftermath) + atlas_r380fx2 (nuke2 hybrid blast); each name in one page
anchor: kind building/ruin/ground: draw at (cell_x*4 - ax, (cell_y + fd)*4 - ay), cell = NW cell of the footprint
anchor_units: kind unit*/fx*: ax, ay = anchor pixel (draw at world_px - (ax, ay)); frame = state*dirs + dir, dir k = heading k*22.5 deg clockwise from east (k=0 east, 4 south, 12 north). Strips are trimmed to their content, so always use each sprite's own w/h/ax/ay
local_px: per-dir lists are px offsets from the unit anchor with the 3/4 lift included; building points ("door", "spots", ...) are frame-local px

carrier_sink_0.note: sinking stage 0 (v6: only 0 settling + fires and 2 gone: foam, oil, debris; carrier_sink_1 was removed, go 0 -> 2); frame = dir8 = posmod(roundi(dir16 / 2.0), 8). Parked aircraft go down with stage 2 (stop drawing them).

carrier_wake.note: frame = phase*16 + dir; apex at the anchor: draw at the carrier stern offset BEFORE the hull; alternate phase 0/1 at ~3 fps while moving; alpha ~ speed (0 when stopped)

carrier_sink_2.note: sinking stage 2 (v6: only 0 settling + fires and 2 gone: foam, oil, debris; carrier_sink_1 was removed, go 0 -> 2); frame = dir8 = posmod(roundi(dir16 / 2.0), 8). Parked aircraft go down with stage 2 (stop drawing them).

silo.note: base map object (doors closed). Door animation = overlays silo_0..5 (same w/h/ax/ay: draw at the same position on top). door = frame-local px of the shaft centre.

airbase.note: airbase 40x28 cells (airfield 30x11). spots = [x, y, dir16] frame-local parking centres for fighters / strike jets (0-5 apron row, 6-9 inside the earth revetments), all nose north (dir 12); spots_heavy = 3 airlifter stands (transport_jet / heli_tr), nose north; runways = [x0, y, x1, y] centrelines (take-off rolls west->east, dir 0, or reverse); taxi = waypoints (apron exits / runway entries). airbase_ground = paving + markings only (same anchor) if aircraft must be drawn between ground and structures.

abm_site.note: strategic missile-defence site 10x8 cells. Draw abm_radar_k (same w/h/ax/ay) on top, k = int(t*2) % 8 (45 deg per frame, ~1 rev / 4 s; faster when tracking). hatch = interceptor silo hatch centre (abm_interceptor launches here, dir 12); radar = turntable centre.

silo_anim.note: full frames 0 closed .. 5 open (alternative to silo + overlays)

para_cargo.note: vehicle on a drop platform under 3 canopies; 2 sway frames

heli_tr_rotor.spin: clockwise, 20 deg per frame (3 blades: 6 frames = 1 cycle)

para_trooper.note: frame 0 opening (show ~0.4 s after exit), then loop 1,2,1,3 (~4 fps). Draw at the trooper ground pos lifted by altitude; shadow: 2x1 rock_deep dot at the ground pos. Not rotated.

abm_interceptor.note: strategic interceptor; launches from abm_site.hatch (dir 12), fast arc

para_canopy_small.note: frame 0 small canopy in the air (supply drop), 1 collapsed canopy lying on the ground (leave ~20 s)

flare.note: IR decoy flare; spawn 4-8 in a fan behind/below the aircraft, fall + drift ~1.5 s, trail = existing smoke puffs; night: additive OK

abm_radar.note: antenna overlay, frame k = rotation k*45 deg clockwise; same anchor as abm_site

transport_jet.note: para drop points: ramp (cargo / vehicles) and the two side doors (troopers), [dir]->[dx,dy]; night red interior light: put a 1-px alert_red at ramp

nuke_missile.note: strategic missile, 15 px (ballistic "missile" = 9 px). nozzle [dir] = exhaust point for the flame / smoke trail. Launch: dir 12 (pointing up) rising from the silo door, then pitch over along the arc.

nuke_stage.note: spent first stage tumbling (8 frames = one turn). Spawn at the missile nozzle at separation (~40 % of the arc), drift back + fall ~2 s, fade; puff of smoke_light at the separation point.

silo_door.note: door overlays on top of silo, same anchor: 0 closed .. 5 open. Launch: 0->5 over ~1.6 s, hold 5 while nuke_missile (dir 12) rises from "door", 5->0 after.

navfighter_ab.note: afterburner lit (catapult stroke, climb-out, intercept): swap with navfighter, flicker 1/2 frames at ~12 fps

navfighter_wing_folded.note: wings fully swept: parked on deck / taxi / catapult / high-speed dash; shadow = navfighter_shadow_folded

heli_tr_body.note: hubs [dir][2] -> [dx,dy] of the front / rear rotor hub (lift included); draw heli_tr_rotor centred on each hub AFTER the body: rear first, front on top; front frame = phase, rear frame = (6 - phase) % 6 (counter-rotating). Ramp = rear loading ramp (troops exit).

heli_tr_shadow.note: body only; rotor discs cast no shadow (as heli)

nuke_flame.note: exhaust flame of nuke_missile: draw at missile pos + nozzle[dir], frame = phase*16 + dir (cycle phases at ~15 fps); add the smoke trail from existing fx

carrier.note: 16 dirs, nose right at frame 0. Draw order: carrier_wake (at stern), carrier, deck aircraft, carrier_island (same anchor/frame: re-draws the island over parked/taxiing aircraft). Per-dir px offsets from the anchor (3/4 lift included): bow/stern [dir]->[dx,dy]; slots [dir][4] AD module mounts (navy mod_* 9x9 centred, as ship slots); cats [dir][4] -> [x0,y0,x1,y1] catapult launch-start (aircraft sits here) -> deck-edge end, cats 0/1 bow (port/stbd), 2/3 waist (on the angled deck); land [dir][5] -> approach point 14 px astern+6 px up, round-down (touchdown start), wires (hook catches), roll-out stop, angled-deck forward end (bolter take-off); spots [dir][6] parking centres (0-2 bow starboard row, 3-4 aft of the island along the deck, 5 forward of the island), spots_local[i][3] = parked heading relative to the bow (deg clockwise, add to ship heading); elevators [dir][4]; island = mast base. *_local = [u fwd, v stbd, z] in px for your own maths (rotate by heading, y -= z).
carrier.split_note: STUB: 16-dir keys live here; pixels are in carrier_a (dirs 0..7) and carrier_b (dirs 8..15): draw <name>_a frame d for d < 8, else <name>_b frame d - 8. x/y/w/h/frames here = strip _a (so old code drawing frames 0..7 still works)

carrier_island.note: island + masts only, pixel-identical to carrier; draw after deck aircraft
carrier_island.split_note: STUB: 16-dir keys live here; pixels are in carrier_island_a (dirs 0..7) and carrier_island_b (dirs 8..15): draw <name>_a frame d for d < 8, else <name>_b frame d - 8. x/y/w/h/frames here = strip _a (so old code drawing frames 0..7 still works)

carrier_shadow.split_note: STUB: 16-dir keys live here; pixels are in carrier_shadow_a (dirs 0..7) and carrier_shadow_b (dirs 8..15): draw <name>_a frame d for d < 8, else <name>_b frame d - 8. x/y/w/h/frames here = strip _a (so old code drawing frames 0..7 still works)

carrier_dmg.note: heavily damaged (< ~40 % hp): scorched deck, holes, fires + smoke, broken mast; same anchors as carrier; no carrier_island overlay needed
